description: Selects one entity from the check_coverage results (idx, starting at 0) and returns the x402 payment requirements for a report (USDC on Base, exact amount in the requirements). This tool does not pay. To pay, send the signed payment in a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header to the returned pay_url, then read the report with get_report.

company.description: Same company name used in check_coverage.

country.description: Same country code used in check_coverage.

idx.description: Index of the chosen entity in the check_coverage candidates.
